description: This file defines the 'Header' class within the GuzzleHttp PSR7 namespace. It provides static methods for parsing, normalizing, and splitting HTTP header values, focusing on handling header strings in HTTP messages.

classes.name: Header
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods for parsing and handling HTTP headers.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses an array of header values containing ';' separated data into an array of associative arrays representing header key-value pairs.

methods.name: normalize
methods.description: Converts header values that may contain comma-separated lists into an array of individual header values; deprecated in favor of splitList.

methods.name: splitList
methods.description: Splits a header value string into an array of individual values, accounting for quoted strings and escaped characters; used for headers like 'accept' and 'cache-control'.
